margin_liquidation_worked.identity: a switch whose identity is the value: a margin call's liquidation sends each contract's sale again for what is left while its book still takes some, as a broker works a market order; a long option no book bids stays held
margin_liquidation_worked.inert_through_pt_v21: inert at 0.0 as shipped through pt-v21: a margin call's liquidation sends each contract's sale once, as it stood; read by `Portfolio.settle_open`, not the engine; at 0.0 it is also left out of the model's digest

margin_option_scan_range.what_would_determine_it: pt-v22 ships 0.15. FINRA Rule 4210(g)(2)(F) takes a portfolio-margin account's theoretical gains and losses at ten equidistant valuation points over plus and minus 15% for any product that is, or is based on, an equity security (`ModelParams::margin_option_scan_range` doc; docs/MODEL.md). A rule's figure taken as written, not an estimate, and graded with pt-v22's whole vector (validation/pt-v22/).
margin_option_scan_range.inert_through_pt_v21: inert at 0.0 as shipped through pt-v21: the single-name scan keeps its own size, at SPAN's seven points; read only with `margin_scan_coverage` on; at 0.0 it is also left out of the model's digest

pinned_vix_return.estimator: least squares of the S&P 500's daily log return on the VIX's daily change in points, 1990-2025, standard error by resampling years; flat in the VIX's level (-0.517, -0.559, -0.523 and -0.539 per cent a point under 20, 20-30, 30-40 and above 40), so one slope
pinned_vix_return.script: a least-squares fit without intercept, per VIX point, of the tape's same-day ^GSPC log return on the Cboe VIX's change, 1990-2025, by the day's VIX level and pooled; the standard error from 1,000 resamples of years (seed 20261027), in the project's unpublished design notes
pinned_vix_return.inert_through_pt_v21: inert at 0.0 as shipped through pt-v21: a pinned session's market draws keep a zero mean, as they stood; read only on a session whose VIX a caller pins; at 0.0 it is also left out of the model's digest
